issues.description: The problem statement requires Farm.animals to be a List<Animal> implemented using an ArrayList and initialized in the no-arg constructor, but the provided solution declares animals as a Queue<Animal> and initializes it with a LinkedList. This structural mismatch (List/ArrayList vs Queue/LinkedList) can confuse students about the intended collection type and API to use (e.g., add/offer, iteration semantics) and prevents directly using the solution as the canonical reference for the assignment instruction.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the collection type consistent. Either (A) update the solution to use a List<Animal> and initialize animals = new ArrayList<>(); with get/set methods returning List<Animal>, or (B) revise the problem statement and UML to specify a Queue/LinkedList if FIFO semantics were intended. Prefer (A) to match the current assignment text which explicitly asks for an ArrayList.
